title: Kensei2 Multimodal Trajectory
description: Schema for OpenClaw multimodal RL data collection trajectories. Validates structure, required metadata, message format, and multimodal asset declarations.

schema_version.description: Schema version identifier. Bump on breaking changes.

task_type.description: Taxonomy slug in format: l1_category__l2_subcategory (double underscore separator). Derived from L1/L2 display names by lowercasing, replacing spaces and punctuation with underscores.

task_description.description: Full natural language description of the task including what the agent must accomplish and why multimodal input is necessary.

task_completion_status.description: Whether the trajectory demonstrates successful task completion.

system_prompt.description: The full system prompt given to the agent. Must define available tools and behavioral constraints.

platform.description: Operating system or platform the task targets.

modality_tags.description: Explicit tags for how multimodal content enters the trajectory.

taxonomy_l1.description: Top-level taxonomy category from the Kensei2 spec.

taxonomy_l2.description: Second-level taxonomy subcategory. Must correspond to a valid L2 under the chosen L1.

media_necessity.description: Explicit justification for why the media is NECESSARY (not decorative). Must explain why text-only input would be insufficient.

cross_modal_reasoning.description: Structured representation of how different modalities are reconciled or compared during the trajectory. Spec requires ≥50% of tasks to fuse ≥2 modalities.

percentage.description: Estimated percentage of task steps that require cross-modal reasoning (fusing information from ≥2 modalities).

modalities_fused.description: Which modalities are fused/compared during reasoning.

description.description: Free-text explanation of what cross-modal reasoning occurs.

input_modalities.description: MIME types of input media (e.g., image/heic, application/pdf, image/png).

output_modalities.description: Types of output the agent produces.

asset_realism_notes.description: Notes on why the assets look realistic (messy filenames, mixed formats, natural imperfections like blur or bad lighting).

input_files.description: Manifest of all files provided to the agent at task start.

environment.description: Execution environment specification for reproducibility. Optional — omit for tasks that don't require a specific runtime.

output_artifacts.description: Manifest of artifacts produced by the agent (generated images, CSVs, PDFs, reports, etc.). Empty array if task produces no file artifacts.

_extensions.description: Arbitrary vendor or project extensions. No schema validation applied to contents.

messages.description: Ordered conversation messages forming the trajectory. First message MUST be a user prompt. Minimum: a user prompt and an assistant response.

_extensions.description: Top-level arbitrary vendor or project extensions. No schema validation applied to contents.

ref_id.description: Stable identifier for this input file, referenced by source_ref in media content blocks to link manifest entries to inline usages.

filename.description: Realistic filename as it would appear on the user's device (e.g., IMG_3847.HEIC, scan_receipt_pg2.pdf).

mime_type.description: MIME type of the file. Must match the actual data encoding.

size_bytes.description: File size in bytes. Optional but recommended for realism.

role.description: The role this file plays in the task.

description.description: What this file contains and why it's needed for the task.

source.description: S3 URI or HTTPS URL where the input file is stored.

filename.description: Expected output filename (e.g., solutions.md, catalog.pdf, etsy_listings.csv).

mime_type.description: MIME type of the output artifact.

source.description: S3 URI or HTTPS URL where the generated artifact is stored.

artifact_type.description: Classification of the output artifact type.

description.description: What this artifact contains and how it relates to the task outcome.

image.description: Container image or VM image identifier.

pre_installed.description: Software packages pre-installed in the environment.

network_access.description: Whether the agent has outbound network access.

working_directory.description: Absolute path to the agent's working directory.

provided_files.description: Absolute paths to files placed in the environment before task starts.

id.description: Unique message identifier. Any non-empty string (UUID, nanoid, sequential, etc.).

turn_index.description: Zero-based sequential position in the conversation. Monotonically increasing; no gaps allowed.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the message was created.

toolCallId.description: Required for toolResult messages. References the tool call this is responding to.

toolName.description: Name of the tool that produced this result. Required for toolResult messages.

isError.description: Whether this tool result represents an error. Required for toolResult messages.

mimeType.description: MIME type of the image. Must match the actual encoding of the referenced asset.

source.description: S3 URI or HTTPS URL referencing the image asset.

source_ref.description: References an InputFile.ref_id from meta_info.input_files, linking this inline usage to the manifest entry.

mimeType.description: MIME type of the video (e.g., video/mp4, video/webm).

source.description: S3 URI or HTTPS URL referencing the video asset.

source_ref.description: References an InputFile.ref_id from meta_info.input_files, linking this inline usage to the manifest entry.

duration_seconds.description: Duration of the video in seconds.

mimeType.description: MIME type of the audio (e.g., audio/mpeg, audio/wav, audio/ogg).

source.description: S3 URI or HTTPS URL referencing the audio asset.

source_ref.description: References an InputFile.ref_id from meta_info.input_files, linking this inline usage to the manifest entry.

duration_seconds.description: Duration of the audio in seconds.

thinkingSignature.description: Cryptographic signature of thinking content (optional, for verification).

id.description: Unique identifier for this tool invocation.

name.description: Name of the tool being called. Must match a tool defined in the system_prompt.

arguments.description: Arguments passed to the tool. Structure varies by tool.
